{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|Soldier}}
[[File:Elite_soldier_TotG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] elite soldier]]
{{Quote|A good soldier always knows how to use whatever equipment is at hand: computers, droids, vehicles, communications gear, and - of course - weapons. Knowing what a weapon is capable of - and more importantly, what it isn't capable of - can save your life in a tough situation.|[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Marck Linth]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|SpecForces]] (5th Regiment)|<ref name="Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>}}
'''Soldiers''' were individuals trained in a variety of martial skills and represented the core of any military force. Many of these individuals volunteered to fight for their government, but some were drafted into service. Those who fought for monetary payment were generally called [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]]. Soldiers received basic training in a wide range of weaponry and combat tactics, from [[Unarmed combat/Legends|hand-to-hand combat]] to heavy weapons. Soldiers that received advanced training and equipment were called [[Commando/Legends|commandos]].

==Description==
Soldiers were disciplined and skilled warriors with extensive martial skills. Individuals took up the profession for a number of reasons. Some sought a better life than the mundane one they lived previously, while others joined the military to follow in the footsteps of their family. The lure of leading an adventurous life as a brave warrior, revelling in the thrill of battle and fighting for glory, appealed to many. Others saw it as their duty to defend the weak and those in need, upholding honorable ideals and righting wrongs. Selfish reasons could also drive a soldier as they used their strength to engage in acts of cruelty and kill as they wanted, gaining power and wealth.<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

Most soldiers received formal training from a military organization or academy, such as planetary armed forces, local [[Militia/Legends|militias]], or private [[Army/Legends|armies]]. Some are self-taught, learning by first-hand experience. Well trained in a number of fighting techniques, each soldier usually developed their own style and combat specialities. Soldiers continued to hone their skills as they gained more combat experience, and would begin to favor certain weapons and specializations. Soldiers could be known by a number of names, including guards, [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]], champions, enforcers, [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], thugs, warriors, soldiers-of-fortune, or adventurers.<ref name="RPG-Core" />

Particularly talented soldiers received advanced combat training, resulting in highly-trained and motivated elite troopers. These soldiers were fully capable of undertaking a number of combat missions and were expert marksmen and hand-to-hand combatants. While well trained in the use of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and [[Armor/Legends|armor]], they could also operate without equipment if needed. Elite soldiers relied on their own skill and ingenuity to complete their missions, and were particularly suited for operations behind enemy lines conducting guerrilla warfare. These veteran soldiers were often put in command of other troopers, with the intention being that the rookies would both benefit from their experience and that the soldier's presence would help to keep them alive in combat. Elite troops could also be clustered into small units, where they were employed as [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteurs]] and [[Commando/Legends|commandos]], or were trained to fight in specific environments.<ref name="RPG-Core" />

==History==
{{Quote|Since the first Taung chieftain raised his spear to signal a charge, soldiers have nobly shed blood for the glory of a greater cause.|[[High General]] [[Cassio Tagge/Legends|Cassio Tagge]], ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''|<ref name="IH">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
[[File:AoRGMK_FC_character_art.png|thumb|left|200px|A female Human and male Duros soldier for the Rebel Alliance]]
Soldiers of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that served during the [[Old Republic era]] consisted of [[Republic soldier]]s and [[Republic trooper]]s. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Republic's infantry force consisted mainly of [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]]. The basic soldiers of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] were the [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|Imperial Army troopers]] and the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], who were almost exclusively [[Human/Legends|Human]]. During the [[Rebellion era]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] standard foot soldiers were the [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troopers]], while the specially trained soldiers were called [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|SpecForce]], or Alliance Special Forces.<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy">''[[Threats of the Galaxy]]''</ref>

Small teams of soldiers were sometimes organized into [[Squad/Legends|squads]] which consisted of four to six members and led by a higher ranking soldier. Two or more squads together formed a [[Company/Legends|company]]. In the lead of large groups of soldiers were [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] who had great knowledge of tactics and strategy which enabled those under their command to fight with enhanced efficiency.<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy" /> The combined forces of soldiers who fought on foot were usually referred to as [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]].

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Good soldiers follow orders.|[[Tup/Legends|Tup]], upon activation of his [[Inhibitor chip/Legends|inhibitor chip's]] [[Order 66/Legends|Clone Protocol 66]]|<ref name="TheUnknown">{{TCW|The Unknown}}</ref>}}
Soldier was one the eight starting classes established in the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook|Core Rulebook]] for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''. [[Vor'en Kurn]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]], served as the character example for the class. A prestige class also detailed in the same book was the Elite Trooper.<ref name="RPG-Core" /> 

Soldier is a playable starting class for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''.
